info.name: Slash Infotech CRM - Tasks Subsystem (Phase 6.3.2)
info.description: Postman API Collection covering all 8 endpoints of the Task Management and Assignment subsystem implemented in Phase 6.3.2: Task Creation, Listing, Personal Tasks, Details, Updates, Reassignments with closed verification loop, Soft Deletion, and History Audit.

request.description: Updates mutable task fields (title, description, priority, category, status, progress, dates, tags). Records status history and activity logs.

response.name: 200 OK - Task Updated

request.description: Atomically reassigns a task to another employee using Tier 1 ascending locks and closed verification loop. Automatically recalculates task department and records TaskAssignmentHistory.

response.name: 200 OK - Task Reassigned
409 Conflict - Concurrency Contention

request.description: Soft-deletes a task by recording deletedAt timestamp. Preserves all assignment, status, and activity audit trails.
Retrieves comprehensive chronological audit trails for a task: assignment history, status transitions with comments, and detailed activity logs.

response.name: 200 OK - History Audit Trail Returned

request.description: Lists all task tags along with counts of associated tasks.
Creates a new task tag. Requires tasks.manage_tags permission.
Deletes a task tag and cascade removes associations from tasks. Requires tasks.manage_tags permission.
